Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1213
Claimant:
Cassandra Herrera
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
07/15/2024
Claim received from the policyholder's driver reporting a low-speed head-on collision in a parking area, with a back
strain as the reported injury. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and has been aksed to confirm the policy
details, which match our records.
08/20/2024
Reviewed the photos submitted by the claimant. They confirm some details of the impact, and the damage shown on
the vehicle is consistent with the described collision. No independent witnesses have come forward, but the police
report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time.
09/03/2024
Spoke with the claimant again today. The account of how the collision happened matched what was given at first
report, with the same sequence of events and the same details. No prior damage to the vheicle is known, and nothing
in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
09/10/2024
Checked medical records provided by the claimant. The back strain fits the kind and force of a low-speed impact, and
no earlier injury to the same area appears in the history. Treatment followed a usual course and eased off as the
claimant improved.
11/21/2024
Compared the repair estimate with the damage visible in the photos and the described impact. The scope of repairs
lines up well with what the collision would be expected to cause. No concerns raised about the vehicle's condition
before the loss.
12/12/2024
File reviewed and all items on hand. The claimant's account stayed consistent throughout, the injury, vehicle damage,
and coverage timing all fit the facts reported, and the claim is ready for the next settlement step.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
